- Plants are notably pale/yellowish-green
- Very early seedling stage
- Some leaves appear lighter colored, almost chlorotic
- Small, early-stage plants with pale coloration

This matches **Downy mildew** symptoms: "Infected seedlings are pale yellow or have light-colored striping or mottling on leaves." The reference images confirm young pale/chlorotic seedlings as a hallmark of this disease. The pale yellowish appearance of the young plants, early seedling stage, and similarity to the reference collage all strongly support this diagnosis.
